stdout:
List playlists. Use this tool to list playlists.

Usage:
  yutu playlist list [flags]

Examples:
# List my playlists
yutu playlist list --mine
# List playlists by channel ID with limit
yutu playlist list --channelId UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw --maxResults 10
# List specific playlists in JSON format
yutu playlist list --ids PLxxx1,PLxxx2 --output json

Flags:
  -c, --channelId string                       Return the playlists owned by the specified channel id
  -h, --help                                   help for list
  -l, --hl string                              Return content in specified language
  -i, --ids strings                            Return the playlists with the given Ids for Stubby or Apiary
  -n, --maxResults int                         The maximum number of items that should be returned, 0 for no limit (default 5)
  -M, --mine                                   Return the playlists owned by the authenticated user (default true)
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string          ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwnerChannel string   YouTube channel ID linked to the content owner
  -o, --output string                          json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -p, --parts strings                          Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet,status])
